newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB's Rich saYs fx market calm as Swiss rates fall.
newsitem.headline: SNB's Rich saYs fx market calm as Swiss rates fall.

text.p: Swiss National Bank chief economist Georg Rich said he believed the situation on currency markets had calmed after recent declines in Swiss money market rates.
"Interest rates have fallen...and that has calmed the market," he told reporters when asked about foreign exchange activity after weekend French elections.
He said currency markets had reacted more strongly to German Finance Minister Theo Waigel's plan to revalue German gold reserves.
